description: 초등 1~6학년 학습 범위를 바탕으로 구성한 연습 단원. 학교별 교과서 단원 번호와 다를 수 있습니다.

1.operandRule: edge count 3 or 4; orientation context 0..2; only level 1 supported
edge count 3..6; orientation context 0..2; only level 1 supported
X,Y each 20..40 degrees in steps of 10; third angle 180−X−Y >0

2.operandRule: X,Y each 20..50 degrees in steps of 10; third angle 180−X−Y >0

3.operandRule: X,Y each 20..60 degrees in steps of 10; third angle 180−X−Y >0

4.operandRule: X,Y each 20..70 degrees in steps of 10; third angle 180−X−Y >0

5.operandRule: X,Y each 20..80 degrees in steps of 10; third angle 180−X−Y >0

1.operandRule: P 10..90 in steps of 10; total 100..300 in steps of 100

2.operandRule: P 10..90 in steps of 10; total 100..400 in steps of 100

3.operandRule: P 10..90 in steps of 10; total 100..500 in steps of 100

4.operandRule: P 10..90 in steps of 10; total 100..600 in steps of 100

5.operandRule: P 10..90 in steps of 10; total 100..700 in steps of 100
